sources.title: NIST AI RMF Playbook — Measure
sources.status: Official substantive HTML sections freshly opened and read
sources.inspection_scope: Page line44 notes framework update in progress. Read Measure1.1 lines54–82, Measure2.1 lines183–199 and Measure2.3 lines278–301: documented metrics/test material, deployment-context evaluation, and distinction between computational tests and actual impacts.
sources.use: Bounded test-set/metric documentation and evaluation-versus-impact distinction. All counts, policies, assumptions, losses and deployment gates are original.
sources.limits: No full-page or linked-paper/software audit claimed. Neighboring human-subject/legal sections not adopted as legal guidance. No certification or universal safety claim inferred.

prerequisite_reuse.v18-c08: Own complete frozen chapter: cash/resources, accountable execution and internal appetite versus legal authority; C09 replaces bank allocation with process flow and AI routing.
prerequisite_reuse.v16-c08: Read accepted assignment, outcome, estimand and fixed-horizon/preanalysis sections1–2; retain no-interference and no outcome-guided stopping discipline.
prerequisite_reuse.v16-c09: Read exact joint randomization and rank-size proof sections; new C09 design is four independently randomized pairs, not reuse of its eight-bank assignment arithmetic.
prerequisite_reuse.probability_and_optimization: Geometric expectation, conservation, bottleneck bounds, binomial inversion and finite-menu proofs derived directly with domains here.

originality: All academic and financial institutions, observations, test counts, assignment records, implementation notes and loss weights are original synthetic specimens. No actual external data, training, experiment, customer rollout or observed leadership claimed.
